description_en: Queries the status and result of a single-file or OSS Bucket batch C2PA signing task
description_zh: 查询单文件或OSS Bucket批量C2PA签名任务的状态和结果
name: GetC2paSignResult

parameters.help_en: The opaque task ID returned by `CreateC2paSignTask`. Maximum length: 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: `CreateC2paSignTask` 返回的不透明任务 ID，最多 64 个字符
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The business error code of this API call. Returns `OK` when the call succeeds
Code.description_zh: 本次接口调用的业务错误码。调用成功时返回 `OK`

ErrorCode.description_en: The task failure error code. Returned only when `Status=FAILED`
ErrorCode.description_zh: 任务失败错误码，仅在 `Status=FAILED` 时返回
ErrorCode.title_en: 任务错误码。Status为FAILED时返回；Bucket因共享依赖故障进入PAUSING或PAUSED时也返回。用户主动暂停或任务进入CANCELED时不返回
ErrorCode.title_zh: 任务错误码。Status为FAILED时返回；Bucket因共享依赖故障进入PAUSING或PAUSED时也返回。用户主动暂停或任务进入CANCELED时不返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The task failure error message. Returned only when `Status=FAILED`
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 任务失败错误信息，仅在 `Status=FAILED` 时返回
ErrorMessage.example: only valid JPEG and PNG source files are supported
ErrorMessage.title_en: 任务错误信息。返回条件与ErrorCode相同
ErrorMessage.title_zh: 任务错误信息。返回条件与ErrorCode相同

FailedCount.description_en: The number of objects that failed, were skipped, or were terminated by the Bucket task. Returned only when the Bucket task is in the SUCCEEDED or CANCELED state
FailedCount.description_zh: Bucket任务签名失败、跳过或被终止的对象数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
FailedCount.title_en: Bucket任务签名失败、跳过或被终止的对象数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
FailedCount.title_zh: Bucket任务签名失败、跳过或被终止的对象数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. Returns `200` when the API call succeeds
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。接口调用成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional message. Returns `success` when the API call succeeds
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。接口调用成功时返回 `success`

ReportFileUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL returned when the Bucket task enters the CANCELED state and the internal JSON report is written successfully. The report covers only objects discovered before termination
ReportFileUrl.description_zh: Bucket任务进入CANCELED且内部JSON报告写入成功时返回的临时下载地址；报告只覆盖终止前已发现的对象
ReportFileUrl.title_en: Bucket任务进入CANCELED且内部JSON报告写入成功时返回的临时下载地址；报告只覆盖终止前已发现的对象
ReportFileUrl.title_zh: Bucket任务进入CANCELED且内部JSON报告写入成功时返回的临时下载地址；报告只覆盖终止前已发现的对象

ReportObjectKey.description_en: The object key of the final standard JSON report for the Bucket task. Returned only when the Bucket task succeeds
ReportObjectKey.description_zh: Bucket任务最终标准JSON报告的Object Key，仅Bucket任务成功时返回
ReportObjectKey.title_en: Bucket任务最终标准JSON报告的Object Key，仅Bucket任务成功时返回
ReportObjectKey.title_zh: Bucket任务最终标准JSON报告的Object Key，仅Bucket任务成功时返回

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 调用的请求 ID

SignedFileUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the signature file. Returned only when `Status=SUCCEEDED`
SignedFileUrl.description_zh: 签名文件的临时下载地址，仅在 `Status=SUCCEEDED` 时返回
SignedFileUrl.title_en: 签名后文件的临时下载地址，仅单文件任务成功时返回
SignedFileUrl.title_zh: 签名后文件的临时下载地址，仅单文件任务成功时返回

Status.title_en: 任务状态。单文件任务取值为PROCESSING、SUCCEEDED或FAILED；Bucket任务还可能返回PAUSING、PAUSED、CANCELING或CANCELED。SUCCEEDED、FAILED和CANCELED为终态；Bucket的SUCCEEDED表示编排和报告完成，不表示所有文件都签名成功
Status.title_zh: 任务状态。单文件任务取值为PROCESSING、SUCCEEDED或FAILED；Bucket任务还可能返回PAUSING、PAUSED、CANCELING或CANCELED。SUCCEEDED、FAILED和CANCELED为终态；Bucket的SUCCEEDED表示编排和报告完成，不表示所有文件都签名成功

SucceededCount.description_en: The number of objects successfully signed by the Bucket task. Returned only when the Bucket task is in the SUCCEEDED or CANCELED state
SucceededCount.description_zh: Bucket任务签名成功的对象数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
SucceededCount.title_en: Bucket任务签名成功的对象数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
SucceededCount.title_zh: Bucket任务签名成功的对象数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回

Success.description_en: Indicates whether this query call is successful. This value may still be `true` even if the task itself has failed
Success.description_zh: 表示本次查询调用是否成功。任务本身失败时，该值仍可能为 `true`

TaskType.description_en: The task type: FILE or BUCKET

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of objects scanned by the Bucket task. Returned only when the Bucket task is in the SUCCEEDED or CANCELED state
TotalCount.description_zh: Bucket任务扫描到的对象总数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
TotalCount.title_en: Bucket任务扫描到的对象总数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
TotalCount.title_zh: Bucket任务扫描到的对象总数，仅Bucket任务SUCCEEDED或CANCELED时返回
